# hiok_storage_lifecycle_rule (Resource)

Moves or deletes objects automatically by age, e.g. delete backups/ after 30 days.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The storage account's id.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `action` (String) delete, cool or archive.
- `blob_prefix` (String) Only keys starting with this, e.g. backups/.
- `days_after_modification` (Number) Age in days before the action applies.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `rule_type` (String) Which objects the rule looks at.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
